downscaleNote: Frames resampled 720x1280 -> 288x512, one frame at a time. The source sheet was 6480x11520, past the 8192 maxTextureSize Kael's sheets import at; Unity would have rescaled it non-uniformly and sheared the frame grid.
tuningNote: impactFraction and playbackSpeed are NOT in the export and are not derived from anything - they are seeded starting values, exactly as Kael's were. Eyeball them in Play mode and retune.
